conclusion: On Windows Ninja builds, adding data members to GCode.hpp can leave direct consumers with stale object layouts. A stale Print.cpp.obj can allocate GCode with the old class size and corrupt members, surfacing as an access violation in m_skirt_group_done.clear() during GCode::do_export. After changing GCode.hpp, rebuild GCode.cpp, Print.cpp, calib.cpp and BeltGCode.cpp together; do not attribute this build-ABI failure to the organic support stage named by the last flushed log line.
